# Palisade policy document

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

A versioned policy document: one policy and the rule sets it uses.

Schema: [`schemas/policy/v1.json`](https://github.com/jusso-dev/palisade/blob/main/schemas/policy/v1.json) (`$id` `https://github.com/jusso-dev/palisade/schemas/policy/v1.json`), version 1.0.0. Regenerate the schema with `PALISADE_BLESS=1 cargo test -p palisade-policy --test schema`, then these pages with `cargo xtask docs generate`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |

## Object types

- [`Action`](action.md): The action of a rule (#34).
- [`Criterion`](criterion.md): A test of one fact about the object or its context: `field operator values`.
- [`Effects`](effects.md): The effect flags of one rule. Unset fields take the action's default.
- [`LibraryRef`](library-ref.md): A reference to a library from a match tree or a hierarchy assignment.
- [`Match`](match.md): A condition tree (#33).
- [`Metadata`](metadata.md): Governance metadata (#40). More fields arrive with #40.
- [`ModeOptions`](mode-options.md): Mode settings besides the base `mode`. Each is optional in a document.
- [`Policy`](policy.md): The decision part of a policy: which rule sets apply, and how.
- [`PolicySettings`](policy-settings.md): Settings that apply to the whole policy. Every field is optional in a document and has the default shown in the schema.
- [`PrecedenceOptions`](precedence-options.md): Settings of the precedence models. Each is optional in a document.
- [`Rule`](rule.md): One rule: a match tree and the action taken when it matches.
- [`RuleSet`](rule-set.md): A named, reusable, ordered collection of rules.

Enumerations and string formats: [Value types](types.md).
